ascend_skill.desc:
Cosmic Yui can summon 4 types of Veggie Knights during battle, and can stack Veggie Energy. When Veggie Energy is stacked, Cosmic Yui can activate Veg-Out Attack. This skill's damage is counted as All-Out Attack damage.
At the start of the turn, gain abilities based on Veggie Knights gained, and change the color of Cosmic Yui's Phantom Thief Attire.
Eggplant Purple: When using a skill, gain 1 more stack of Veggie Energy.
Potato Yellow: Increase Cosmic Yui's All-Out Attack damage by 15%.
Mushroom Red: When dealing damage with a skill or All-Out Attack, 4.5% chance to inflict Brainwash on the target for 1 turn.
Asparagus Green: When dealing damage with a skill or All-Out Attack, restore Cosmic Yui's HP by 1% of the damage dealt (up to a maximum of 1000 at once).
ascend_skill.name: Vegetable Avatar

ascend_skill.desc:
At the start of battle, Cosmic Yui immediately summons all 4 types of Veggie Knights and gains the maximum number of Veggie Energy stacks.
For each Veggie Knight gained, increase Cosmic Yui's critical damage by 8% (up to 5 Veggie Knights).
At the start of battle, Cosmic Yui changes to Potato Yellow state, and at the start of her first turn, automatically change to Eggplant Purple.
ascend_skill.name: Veggie Knight Rounds

ascend_skill.desc:
Gain 1 more Potato Knight that will not be spent.
When activating the Resonance Harvest Havoc, increase Potato Power effects by 10% more.
At the start of battle, gain Potato Power for 2 turns.
ascend_skill.name: Seed Potato Knight

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of Veggie Knights, Go! and Veg-Out Attack by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Veggie Knight Master

ascend_skill.desc: Highlight Enhanced: Increase Cosmic Yui's Attack by 35% for 4 turns.
ascend_skill.name: Cyber Farmer

ascend_skill.desc: Increase the skill levels of Harvest Fest and Thief Tactics by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Starlight Fest

ascend_skill.desc:
Unlock the Prismatic state. Change Cosmic Yui's Phantom Thief Attire to Prismatic Color, and simultaneously gain abilities from Eggplant Purple, Potato Yellow, Mushroom Red, and Asparagus Green.
At the start of battle, permanently enter Huge Harvest state, and change the following effects.
When an ally ends their action, activate the Resonance Harvest Havoc.
When using Veggie Knights, Go!, summon 1 more Potato Knight.
ascend_skill.name: Prismatic Vegetables

highlight_skill.desc: Deal Nuclear damage to 1 foe equal to 439.2%/484.2%/466.2%/511.2% of Attack. Also, according to specific rules, activate Harvest Havoc on the target.
highlight_skill.name: Highlight

normal_skill.desc:
Deal Nuclear damage to 1 foe equal to 120.8%/133.2%/128.3%/140.6% of Attack, gain 3 Veggie Energy stacks, and enter Huge Harvest state until the end of her next turn.
If Potato Knight is present when this skill is used, automatically change to Potato Yellow at the end of the turn.
Huge Harvest: At the end of Cosmic Yui's action, activate the Resonance Harvest Havoc, dealing Nuclear damage to 1 random foe equal to 93.5%/103.1%/99.2%/108.8% of Attack. Also, based on the current state, activate the following effects.
Eggplant Purple: Gain 1 Veggie Energy.
Potato Yellow: Gain Potato Power, and increase All-Out Attack damage by 14.6%/16.1%/15.5%/17.0% for 3 turns.
Mushroom Red: Inflict Shroom Spores on the target, and increase damage taken by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% for 2 turns.
Asparagus Green: Restore 976/1076/1036/1136 HP to the ally with the lowest remaining HP.
normal_skill.name: Harvest Fest

normal_skill.desc:
Increase Cosmic Yui's Attack by 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% and critical rate by 11.7%/12.9%/12.4%/13.6% for 2 turns, and summon 1 Veggie Knight according to a specific order.
After using this skill, other skills can be used on the same turn (this skill is not treated as a normal skill).
Passive: At the start of Cosmic Yui's action, automatically summon 1 Veggie Knight according to a specific order. Up to 1 Eggplant Knight, Mushroom Knight, or Asparagus Knight can be summoned each. Up to 4 Potato Knights can be summoned.
normal_skill.name: Veggie Knights, Go!

normal_skill.desc:
Deal Nuclear damage to 1 foe equal to 130.2%/143.5%/138.2%/151.5% of Attack, and for each Veggie Knight present, deal 1 more hit of Nuclear damage equal to 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% of Attack. Also, if 2 or more Potato Knights are present, spend all but 1 Potato Knight, and for each Potato Knight spent, deal 1 more hit of Nuclear damage equal to 24.4%/26.9%/25.9%/28.4% of Attack. This skill's damage is counted as an All-Out Attack.
When this skill is selected and used, gain 2 Veggie Energy stacks.
If Eggplant Knight is present after activating this skill, automatically change to Eggplant Purple state at the end of the turn.
Passive: At 7 Veggie Energy stacks, able to spend all Veggie Energy stacks to activate damage effect of Veg-Out Attack. Damage is distributed equally among all foes. This is not treated as normal skill damage.
normal_skill.name: Veg-Out Attack

passive_skill.desc: During battle, for each Veggie Knight gained, increase Cosmic Yui's damage by 8.1% (up to 4 Veggie Knights).
passive_skill.name: Veggie Satellite

passive_skill.desc: Increase All-Out Attack damage by 15.0%. When participating in an All-Out Attack, increase that damage more based on the total number of Veggie Knights Cosmic Yui has gained.
passive_skill.name: Mixed Vegetables
